description: MAP-7 rule 6 (amended 2026-09-30): a model name that is not Claude's on an Anthropic-dialect server keeps 16384 when Config.max_tokens is absent — the Claude ceilings are Anthropic's, and these servers publish their own, lower ones (a 128000 default would turn every ordinary call into a 400). Consumer-side; no live wire.

provenance.evidence: docs/mapping-rules.md MAP-7 rule 6 (changes/2026-09-30-claude-code-client-version.md D5); ceilings from Anthropic's Models API max_tokens (receipts/2026-09-30-claude-code/models-max-tokens.json: 128000 for 4.6 and later, 64000 for 4.5) and scrapes/anthropic/pages/models-overview.md (Max output); first authored 2026-09-14 (changes/2026-09-14-adapt-visibly.md §3a)

canonical_request_provenance.evidence: the smallest request with no max_tokens on a non-Claude model
